info.name: IRoute — Manual Hard POD (configurable)
info.description:
End-to-end test after **manual portal setup** (set env vars):
- Booking `{{booking_no}}` (default **BK-0009**)
- Shipment `{{shipment_no}}` (default **SH-0014**, POD Type **Hard**, driver assigned)
- Shipment Document `{{document_record_no}}` (`{{document_ref_no}}`, **Is Delivery Note = Yes**, page 1)

## Import
1. `IRoute_Manual_Hard_POD_Test_Collection.json` (this file — **updated**)
2. `IRoute-Manual-Hard-POD-Test.postman_environment.json`
3. Select environment **IRoute Manual Hard POD — SH-0014**
4. Set `driver_email` + `driver_password` + `mobile_cod_amount` (match shipment COD)

## Mobile UX (updated)
- **A7H is NOT a separate timeline row** — hard copy is **step 2 inside Upload POD** (`pod_capture` screen)
- No orange custody banner before digital A7
- After job closed: `next_action_hint` → dashboard (`job_closed: true`) — no evidence capture screen
- **POD Verified** (`A_POD_VERIFY`) = system auto-step after A9 on COD jobs (not driver action)
- **A8 Unloading** = `execute_action` on `job_detail` — **no** evidence / `pod_capture` screen
- **After A9 (COD)** → system **POD Verified** + status **Delivered** → **A10 Job Closed** (requires **A7H** done for Hard POD)
- **No ops wait popup** when hard copy still due — app routes back to **Upload POD** step 2

## Run order
| Folder | When |
|--------|------|
| **00 Setup** | Login + Job Detail + preflight |
| **01 Workflow → POD** | A5/A6 if needed; A1–A4 if job not started |
| **02 Hard POD** | 11–13 digital A7 → 13b/13c hard copy inside Upload POD → 14–17 A7H |
| **03 COD Close** | **17b** → **18** A8 → **19** A9 → **19b** → **20** A10 |
| **04 Verify** | Job closed checks + History read-only |

## Hard POD A7 portal effect
- **POD-xxxx** child (`IS DN? = No`) — digital evidence
- Manual DN **`{{document_record_no}}`** line **Completion = Completed**
- DN header physical verification = **A7H** (inside Upload POD, not timeline)

## Notes
- `base_url`: `http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/v1/mobile`
- Digital A7: **photo + signature + video** (≤15s)
- Hard copy GET: `pod/capture/?step=hard_copy_confirmation` → `screen=pod_capture`, `screen_title=Upload POD`
- A8 body: JSON only (GPS + notes) — **no** `media[]` / `capture_bundle_id`
- On 409 stale: re-run **03** or **17b Job Detail**

request.description:
A4 requires **2 photos** via multipart form-data (not JSON).

**How to attach photos in Postman:**
1. Body tab → **form-data** (already set)
2. Find rows `media[0][file_ref]` and `media[1][file_ref]` — type must be **File**
3. Click **Select Files** on each row and pick JPG/PNG (e.g. `postman/assets/delay-evidence.jpg`)
4. Do **NOT** set Content-Type header manually — Postman sets multipart boundary
5. Re-run **03 Job Detail** first if you get 409 stale_content_hash

Allowed: jpeg, png, webp. Min 2 photos for A4.

exec: var r=pm.response.json(); pm.test('A4 OK', function () { pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); if(r.status===1&&r.data&&r.data.shipment_id){pm.environment.set('shipment_id',r.data.shipment_id);} if(r.status===1&&r.data&&r.data.sync_metadata){pm.environment.set('content_hash',r.data.sync_metadata.content_hash);pm.environment.set('workflow_version',r.data.sync_metadata.workflow_version);}

request.description:

Digital POD (A7) requires **photo + signature + video** (1 clip, max 15s). Signature is `media_type=signature` — not the same as photo.

1. Re-import this collection if you still see raw JSON
2. Body tab → form-data

4. Run **11** first (pod_content_hash)
5. Saves `capture_bundle_id` for request **13 Execute A7**

Do NOT set Content-Type header manually.
